## Invariants

<!-- invariants:start -->

A voucher is validated server-side at the moment it is applied, never trusted
from the client. Validity covers the window, the enabled flag, the remaining
uses, and the per-customer limit.

A voucher applies to the merchandise subtotal *after* cart-rule discounts, and
a rule may forbid vouchers entirely. Reservation of a use must be atomic with
the order it belongs to, or a depleted voucher can be spent twice under
concurrency.

<!-- invariants:end -->
